map.图书馆读者逾期罚款：读者借书到期未还按日计罚；启用阶梯费率（前 7 天基础、8-: Library reader overdue fines: readers who fail to return books on time are fined per day; enabling a tiered rate (first 7 days base, days 8-30 at 1.5×, over 30 days at 2×) deters long-term hoarding; librarians enter borrow/return dates to auto-issue a fine.
map.资料室内部借用核算：企业资料室对跨部门借用的图纸、标书设封顶上限（如单本最高 5: Internal borrowing accounting in a resource room: a corporate resource room sets a cap (e.g. max 5 CNY per book) on cross-department borrowed drawings and bids to avoid high fines from long loans, using the "cap" switch to bound the per-book maximum.
map.多本同时逾期：读者一次借多本且同日逾期，按本数累加；本工具以「逾期本数」乘以单本: Multiple books overdue at once: a reader borrows several books and they are all overdue on the same day; sum by count; this tool multiplies "overdue count" by the per-book fine to get the total payable, easing a combined fine notice.
map.算例：逾期 40 天 · 0.5 元/天 · 2 本 · 阶梯（未封顶）: Example: 40 days overdue · 0.5 CNY/day · 2 books · tiered (uncapped)
Breakdown: first 7 days 7×0.5 = 3.5 CNY; days 8-30, 23 days ×0.5×1.5 = 17.25 CNY; from day 31, 10 days ×0.5×2 = 10 CNY. Per book total 3.5+17.25+10 = 30.75 CNY; 2 books total 61.50 CNY. | Comparison: if a 50 CNY/book cap is used, the per-book cap is 50 CNY, total 100 CNY (this example does not hit the cap). Without tiering, per book = 40×0.5 = 20 CNY, total 40 CNY.
map.阶梯费率怎么分段？: How is the tiered rate segmented?
map.前 7 天按基础日息；第 8-30 天按 1.5 倍；第 31 天起按 2 倍。: First 7 days at base daily rate; days 8-30 at 1.5×; from day 31 at 2×. The three segments do not overlap and accumulate continuously; overdue days fall into their respective intervals and sum, with no double charging.
map.封顶（上限）怎么用？: How to use the cap (upper limit)?
map.勾选「启用封顶」并填上限，单本罚金超过上限时按上限计、不再累加；适用于资料室内部: Check "Enable cap" and fill the limit; when a per-book fine exceeds the limit, charge the limit instead and stop accumulating; suitable for internal resource-room borrowing where high fines are undesired.
